newsitem.title: USA: Tri-Point files for TraumaSeal pre-market approval.
newsitem.headline: Tri-Point files for TraumaSeal pre-market approval.

text.p: Tri-Point Medical Corp on Monday said it filed a premarket approval application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for TraumaSeal, a topical tissue cohesive.
Tri-Point said it was informed by the Office of Device Evaluations on December 17 that its TraumaSeal PMA would receive "expedited processing."
TraumaSeal is used to close wounds caused by skin lacerations and incisions, minimally invasive surgery and plastic surgery.
In March 1996, Tri-Point entered into a marketing agreement with Ethicon Inc., a division of Johnson & Johnson, for the exclusive worldwide marketing and distribution rights to TraumaSeal.
